scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: the headline H-bond counts and contact angles come from expensive MD simulations that the verifier cannot re-run. The checker compares the agent's reported numbers to paper-reported values with tolerances and verifies structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold H-bond counts and contact angles from the paper (Fig.3 and text), plus structural trend criteria
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b04237, Section 3 (Fig.3 and surrounding text) for monolayer-second-layer H-bonds of (100) surfaces, within-monolayer H-bonds for Pd/Pt/Al(100), and contact angles for Pd/Pt/Al(100). Trend thresholds derived from the paper's conclusions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper text; thresholds derived from paper's description of transition region.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numeric gold values are explicitly reported in the paper; trend conditions are based on the paper's own statements about H-bond competition and wetting behavior.

outputs.description: Hydrogen bond counts and contact angles computed from MD trajectories for all 24 metal/surface systems.

output_contract.notes: The force field validation step produces a validation summary (validation_summary.txt) but is not scored. Only results.json is scored, checked against hidden reference values and structural trend criteria.
